items.title: Relative perfection descends upward through a finite order thickening of the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In a cartesian square of spaces with X' -> Y' flat, finitely presented and Y -> Y' a finite order thickening, if E = Li^*E' is Y-perfect then E' is Y'-perfect. The retained proof: expand Y-perfect as pseudo-coherent plus locally finite tor dimension over f^{-1}O_Y (definition-relatively-perfect); pseudo-coherence lifts through the thickening by the in-source thickening-pseudo-coherent lemma; that puts E' into D_QCoh (Derived Categories of Spaces, pseudo-coherent); affine-locally-rel-perfect reduces the tor-dimension half to the schemes statement (More on Morphisms, thickening-relatively-perfect). Retained author proof at lines 13153-13168.
